# Shift v9 Support

> Comprehensive support documentation for Shift v9, covering authentication, security, billing, and feature configuration.

Shift v9 is a productivity platform that emphasizes secure authentication and account management. The support center provides guidance on implementing 2FA/SSO, understanding payment security compliance, configuring user settings, and managing subscriptions.

## Key Topics

- Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)
- Single Sign-On (SSO)
- Strong Customer Authentication (SCA)
- Google Authenticator
- Microsoft Authenticator
- WebAuthn
- Security Keys
- Windows Hello
- Touch ID
- Account Security
- Authentication Methods
- Shift for Teams
- Stripe Integration
- Account Billing
- Privacy & Security

## Authentication & Security

- [About using 2FA and SSO in Shift](https://supportv9.shift.com/hc/en-us/articles/25227694076564-About-using-2FA-and-SSO-in-Shift): Guide to 2FA and SSO authentication methods in Shift with Google and Microsoft
- [Strong Customer Authentication and Shift](https://supportv9.shift.com/hc/en-us/articles/25227724290452-Strong-Customer-Authentication-and-Shift): Explanation of SCA compliance and payment security via Stripe integration

## Settings & Features

- [How to use link preview settings](https://supportv9.shift.com/hc/en-us/articles/25227915688468-How-to-use-link-preview-settings): How-to guide for configuring link preview settings in Shift

## Billing & Account Management

- [How to apply for a refund](https://supportv9.shift.com/hc/en-us/articles/25227656092052-How-to-apply-for-a-refund): Refund policy and request process for Shift subscriptions

## Getting Started

- [Shift v9](https://supportv9.shift.com/): Shift v9 support center homepage with documentation and help resources
